wiki.title: Weekend at Mort's (S1E11)
wiki.body:
When the health inspector finds mold in the walls, the restaurant gets fumigated and the whole Belcher family moves in next door with **Mort** for the weekend.

## The route
A very short commute: out the front door of Bob's Burgers and straight into the funeral home next door.

## Notes
- Bob and Linda get a rare date night; it derails spectacularly
- The kids discover the crematory, with predictable results
- Follow the walkers on the map to trace the episode
